[quote=north_korea2;60299139]yo im new how do i do this.[/quote]
Well in this region of NationState we have a RP map "Erene2000" that you can send a telegram to Cordone Roleplay Bureau if you want to join,
https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2606469
you joust have to follow the template found on this page (the one called "Joining"):
https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2672817

Other then that its all about figuring out what you want your nation to be, note though that you do not need to use the stats you have in NationStates in any way, instead you start with new stats that go someting like this:
Max Map size(when you start): 40'000 pixels
Max Population: 100 million people/dudes
Max GDP: I tink its 1 trillion, but to be safe ask someone, but the name of the game is to try and keep it nice and reasonable :)

We also have a discord if your able to use that were you can ask around a bit easier/faster (you will find the link on the "world factbook entry" at the top of this page :O
